premises.evidence_of_dependence: try_cast("SEND_TIME" as timestamp) as scheduled_to_send_at ... try_cast("SCHEDULED" as timestamp) as scheduled_at
premises.reason: The contract names both output timestamps but does not establish their source mappings, so an incorrect mapping would change campaign scheduling metadata.
